jobs.description:
Bedrijfsomschrijving

Een positieve toekomst voor iedereen daar werken we bij Sopra Steria aan. Met meer dan 56.000 collega's in 30 landen zijn we Europa's toonaangevende leverancier van digitale oplossingen. Wij weten als geen ander dat het niet alleen technologie is die transformatie aanstuurt. Het zijn mensen die de kern van verandering vormen. Daarom zijn het mensen die centraal staan in alles wat we doen en bieden we een ondersteunende en inclusieve omgeving waar iedereen zowel individueel als in teamverband kan uitblinken.

The world is how we shape it. Let’s shape it together.

Vacatureomschrijving

Heb jij een passie voor Microsoft-technologie en wil je jouw backend-expertise combineren met de dynamiek van moderne frontend-frameworks? Binnen de Microsoft Area van Sopra Steria werk je samen met ervaren engineers aan complexe, impactvolle projecten voor klanten binnen defensie, de publieke sector, financiële dienstverlening en de industrie. Hier combineer je end-to-end vakmanschap met échte maatschappelijke impact en maak je dagelijks het verschil!

Wat ga je doen?

Als Fullstack Developer werk je in multidisciplinaire DevOps-teams aan complexe IT-vraagstukken. Je bent de brug tussen een ijzersterke .NET backend en een intuïtieve, moderne frontend. Je ontwikkelt toekomstbestendige oplossingen en levert code waar je trots op bent: schoon, onderhoudbaar, goed getest en klaar voor de toekomst.

Kwaliteit staat voorop. Geen snelle fixes, maar doordachte oplossingen. Je denkt actief mee over software-architectuur, designkeuzes en technische standaarden, waarbij je zowel de logica in de backend als de performance in de frontend bewaakt.

Een voorbeeld van een opdracht kan het volgende inhouden:

Migraties & Modernisering: Een verouderde Microsoft .NET applicatie (met bijvoorbeeld .NET Framework 4.8) migreren naar .NET 8, en tegelijkertijd de user interface herbouwen in een modern JavaScript-framework zoals Angular, React of Vue.
Cloud & Architectuur: Een nieuwe Azure-omgeving inrichten met Infrastructure as Code (IaC), waarbij je microservices in .NET naadloos laat communiceren met een schaalbare frontend.
Security & Optimalisatie: MFA implementeren in een bestaande applicatie en de API-performance optimaliseren om de laadtijden in de browser drastisch te verkorten.

Functie-eisen

Wat neem jij mee?

Minimaal 2 jaar ervaring als .NET Developer, met sterke kennis van .NET (C#) en moderne .NET Core/.NET 8 architecturen en bij voorkeur ervaring met Azure DevOps en/of Github. Werk jij er nog niet mee? Dan sta jij ervoor open om dit snel eigen te maken.
Naast een sterke backend (.NET)-basis, beschik jij ook over aantoonbare kennis van en ervaring met ten minste één modern JavaScript-framework (zoals Angular, React of Vue).
Ervaring met werken in een Agile/Scrum-omgeving en gewend om samen te werken binnen een DevOps-team.
Een afgeronde hbo- of wo-opleiding in Informatica (of vergelijkbaar), communiceert goed in het Nederlands en werkt graag samen in een team waar kennisdeling centraal staat.
Jij hebt een positieve, oplossingsgerichte mindset en vindt het belangrijk om kwalitatief goede, onderhoudbare code te schrijven.
Jij blijft jezelf ontwikkelen, volgt technologische ontwikkelingen actief, bent gemotiveerd om certificeringen te behalen en het lijkt jou gaaf om onderdeel te worden van onze Microsoft Community waarin kennisdeling centraal staat.

Aanvullende informatie

Dit krijg je van ons!

Bij Sopra Steria zorgen we ervoor dat jij je werk met plezier én in balans kunt doen. Daarom bieden we een aantrekkelijk en flexibel pakket aan arbeidsvoorwaarden:

Een vast contract en een salaris tussen de €4.000,- en €6.000,- bruto per maand (op basis van 40 uur per week, dienstverband minimaal 32 uur).
Bij Sopra Steria vinden we gelijke beloning voor gelijkwaardig werk belangrijk. Daarom bepalen we je salaris op basis van objectieve criteria zoals ervaring, kennis, competenties en verantwoordelijkheden. Zo zorgen we voor een eerlijke en transparante beloning die past bij jouw achtergrond en de impact van je rol.
Vakantiegeld van 8%;
Een winstdelingsregeling met een target-uitkering van 8% van het bruto (parttime) jaarsalaris, afhankelijk van bedrijfsresultaten;
Een mobiliteitsregeling met de keuze uit een elektrische leaseauto of een alternatieve vervoersregeling, passend bij jouw situatie;
27 vakantiedagen, met de mogelijkheid om bovenwettelijke vakantiedagen aan- of te verkopen;
Flexibele hybride werkomstandigheden: thuis, op kantoor of bij de klant, afhankelijk van de functie en de mogelijkheden binnen opdrachten;
Een thuiswerkpakket met laptop, telefoon en een maandelijkse internetvergoeding;
Volop mogelijkheden voor professionele en persoonlijke ontwikkeling via trainingen, certificeringen, kennissessies en inspirerende events;
Diverse sociale activiteiten met collega’s, van informele borrels tot sportieve en inhoudelijke evenementen;
Mogelijkheden voor fiscaal vriendelijke aflossing van jouw studieschuld;
Een uitgebreid aanbod aan voordelen via ons cafetariamodel, waaronder een fietsregeling, sportabonnementen, zonnepanelen en collectieve verzekeringen;
Een pensioenregeling met een werkgeversbijdrage en de mogelijkheid om vrijwillig aanvullende pensioenopbouw te realiseren.
Bij Sopra Steria geloven we in continue groei. Je krijgt de ruimte om je verder te specialiseren binnen Microsoft-technologie en certificeringen te behalen én te onderhouden, zoals AI-200 en AZ-400.

Wat ons écht onderscheidt?

Bij ons draait het niet alleen om projecten, maar ook om jouw groei als Microsoft professional. Je krijgt een persoonlijk ontwikkelplan, begeleiding van ervaren specialisten en alle ruimte om door te groeien naar een volgende stap, technisch én professioneel.

Met meer dan 180 Microsoft-specialisten werk je in één van de grootste Microsoft-communities van Nederland. Van .NET en software-architectuur tot Power Platform, Data & AI en Security kennis is hier overal. We hebben meerdere MVP’s en MCT’s in huis en zijn trots Microsoft Solution Partner.

Kennisdeling en plezier. Maandelijkse track-meetings, inspiratiesessies en een actief Inspirator- en accelerator programma helpen je om jezelf én anderen beter te maken. En natuurlijk bezoeken we samen toonaangevende conferenties zoals Future Tech en maken we ook tijd voor teamuitjes die je niet snel vergeet.

Klaar om te groeien?
 Klaar voor een nieuwe uitdaging bij een bedrijf dat net zo in beweging is als jij? Neem contact op met Mathilda van Delden: mathilda.vandelden@soprasteria.com of solliciteer direct. We kijken ernaar uit je te ontmoeten!

______

Sopra Steria is een werkgever die gelijke kansen biedt. Alle gekwalificeerde sollicitanten worden in aanmerking genomen voor een job zonder rekening te houden met leeftijd, afkomst, nationaliteit, huidskleur, verlof voor familie- of medische zorg, geslachtsidentiteit of -uitdrukking, genetische informatie, immigratiestatus, burgerlijke staat, medische toestand, nationale herkomst, fysieke of mentale handicap, politieke voorkeur, beschermde veteranen- of militaire status, ras, etniciteit, religie, geslacht (inclusief zwangerschap), seksuele geaardheid of enig ander kenmerk dat wordt beschermd door toepasselijke lokale wetten, voorschriften en verordeningen. We koesteren een werkomgeving die inclusief is en alle verschillen respecteert.

jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer - Product (Remote)
jobs.description:
About Finom

Finom is a European tech startup headquartered in Amsterdam, and we’re on a journey towards revolutionizing the financial landscape for entrepreneurs worldwide. Our mission is to develop an all-in-one financial B2B solution that integrates banking functions, accounting, financial management, and invoicing into a seamless, mobile-first platform.

We recently closed a €115 million Series C equity round
(around $133 million), bringing our total funding to approximately $346 million. This significant investment follows a $105 million growth funding round from General Catalyst, a long-term backer since 2021 known for supporting companies like Airbnb, HubSpot, KAYAK, and Stripe.

Finom's platform goes beyond traditional banking, offering invoicing and a growing suite of features, including AI-enabled accounting, aiming to simplify financial management for entrepreneurs. We're actively expanding our reach across key EU markets like Germany, France, the Netherlands, Italy, and Spain.

At Finom, we’re not just redefining the entrepreneurial experience — we’re empowering our employees to make a real difference. Your work matters, and your impact extends far beyond product metrics. We nurture innovation and an inspiring work environment where bold ideas thrive, prioritizing thorough research, swift implementation of solutions, and ensuring that every effort we make benefits our users, employees, partners, and our business as a whole.

Maintaining our start-up spirit, we prioritize thorough research, swift implementation of solutions, and ensuring that every effort we make benefits our users, employees, partners, and, of course, our business.

We're looking for a Senior Backend Engineer
who thinks like a product builder, thrives in a collaborative, cross-functional environment, and is passionate about creating robust, scalable financial infrastructure. You'll be part of a domain team where various engineering crafts (Backend, Frontend, Mobile, ML/AI engineers, and QA) work together to own and evolve a shared product area that delivers real value to hundreds of thousands of businesses across Europe.

About You and What You'll Do:

You're pragmatic, learn quickly, and have a proven track record of shipping products that matter. You communicate clearly across disciplines and genuinely enjoy the dynamics of a cross-functional team where everyone contributes to solving the same customer problems. Above all, you're curious - about the product, the users, the business, and how your technical decisions impact all three.

As a product-minded backend engineer, you don't just implement tickets. You understand the "why" behind what you're building, challenge assumptions when needed, and proactively identify opportunities to create better outcomes. You're comfortable discussing trade-offs with product managers, explaining technical constraints to business stakeholders, and collaborating with frontend and mobile engineers to design elegant end-to-end solutions.

You have deep expertise in .NET and C# with a strong appreciation for maintainable, scalable code, and distributed architectures. But more importantly, you know when to apply that expertise and when simpler solutions serve the product better. You've built data-intensive applications before and understand the concepts of working in a regulated environment.

You take ownership not just of your code, but of the outcomes. You move without being prompted, whether that's jumping into a customer issue, improving team processes, or mentoring colleagues. You're curious about adjacent domains - you might peek at the frontend code, ask questions about the ML models, or dive into analytics to understand how features perform.

Quality is non-negotiable for you. Automated testing, thorough code reviews, and security best practices are fundamental to how you work. You balance technical excellence with pragmatism, always keeping the end user and business goals in mind.

Your experience includes:

At least 5 years of professional backend development with a product engineering mindset
Excellent knowledge of .NET platform and C#
Hands-on experience architecting and evolving distributed systems in production
Proven ability to collaborate effectively with product managers, designers, and engineers from other disciplines
Strong business acumen - you understand how your work connects to company objectives
Clear, concise communication in English across technical and non-technical audiences
A builder's mentality: you care deeply about shipping great products, not just writing great code

Our tech stack

Backend: .NET/C#, PostgreSQL, Redis, RabbitMQ, Kafka, Kubernetes, GCP.
You'll work alongside teams using React (Web), Swift (iOS) / Kotlin (Android), Python/ML frameworks, and modern test automation tools (Playwright, Appium).

Recruitment flow:

Recruiter Interview
First Technical Interview
System Design Interview
Team Fit Interview (peer interview)
Offer

What You Will Get In Return

Make a genuine impact on the product

Join our upward trajectory, and grow with us. We provide the resources and opportunities for continuous personal and professional development, empowering you to make a genuine impact on our evolving product.

Work in the EU

Embark on this exciting journey with us and enjoy the flexibility of traveling and working remotely or in a hybrid model across Europe.

Become a stock options holder

Unlock your inner entrepreneur and align your aspirations with ours through our Stock Options Program. This exciting opportunity is available to every team member, from junior team members to our founders.

Receive unwavering support and care

Finom stands by you at every step, embodying our commitment to your well-being and success reflected in our modern, friendly, and eco-conscious corporate culture. We offer constant support and care to ensure your Finom experience is successful and fulfilling.

Work & Swim program

Immerse yourself in our exclusive Work & Swim Program. Spend one month in a comfortable corporate apartment in enchanting Cyprus. It's the ideal opportunity to strike the perfect work-life balance while enjoying breathtaking Mediterranean views.

Equal Opportunity Statement

At Finom, we're an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We embrace diversity and invite applications from all walks of life. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability status, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

jobs.title: Backend Developer
jobs.description:
What is your role?

At Lely, we develop technology that helps shape the future of sustainable dairy farming. From robotic systems to digital farm management solutions, software plays a crucial role in creating reliable, scalable products that support farmers worldwide.

As a Backend Developer, you contribute to the digital backbone behind our robotic ecosystem. You work on systems that enable reliable communication, data processing, and robot management at scale. Your work directly supports innovations that improve animal welfare, farm efficiency, and sustainable food production.

In this role, you collaborate closely with software engineers, product owners, and other stakeholders in multidisciplinary Scrum teams. Together, you design and improve scalable backend services, translate business needs into technical solutions, and continuously strengthen the quality, performance, and security of our platforms.

Your main responsibilities

Designing, developing, and maintaining robust and scalable backend services and RESTful APIs.
Collaborating with multidisciplinary teams to translate functional requirements into sustainable technical solutions.
Contributing to the development of future-proof platform modules and ensuring smooth integration with existing systems.
Improving software quality, maintainability, and performance through testing, refactoring, and continuous improvement.
Helping ensure secure and reliable systems by contributing to authentication, authorization, and cybersecurity best practices.

Apply now

What is your experience?

You are a software Developer who enjoys building reliable systems and solving technical challenges together with others. You combine a structured and analytical mindset with curiosity and a strong sense of ownership. You feel comfortable working in a multidisciplinary environment where software contributes directly to robotics and digital innovation.

You will likely recognize yourself in much of the following:

A bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
At least 3 years of experience in backend software development.
Experience with C#, JavaScript or TypeScript, and modern backend frameworks such as ASP.NET Core or ExpressJS.
Experience designing and developing RESTful APIs and building scalable backend systems.
Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, Git, and cloud or container technologies such as Azure, Docker, or Kubernetes.
An interest in software quality, testing, and secure development practices, including authentication and authorization concepts.
Familiarity with cyber security (authentication, authorization, threat modeling).
Strong collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across disciplines and translate requirements into practical solutions.
A self-starting personality. You are someone who doesn’t wait for instructions and who starts designing and prototyping to prove whether concepts work or not.

What you can expect from us

Working at Lely means contributing to sustainable progress within one of the most innovative organizations in the Netherlands. You help make the agricultural sector more futureproof, and we ensure you have the space, resources, and support to do so.

An international work environment that values collaboration, initiative, and diverse perspectives.
A culture that encourages learning, experimentation, and ownership of ideas.
Excellent employment conditions, including up to 8 weeks of vacation per year and a strong pension scheme.
A Salary range of €5,000 - €7,100 gross per month, with clear opportunities for growth within the scale.
Full ownership of your own development, with access to a wide range of courses through the Lely Academy.
Daily access to outstanding sports facilities at the Lely Campus: an indoor gym, outdoor padel courts, basketball and volleyball courts, table tennis, and table football. You can join Hyrox workouts or sign up for personal training and challenge your colleagues during an active break.
Fresh coffee and tea from our own barista (with milk from our own farm) and a healthy, affordable company restaurant.

Work-life balance

A healthy work-life balance thanks to our hybrid working policy: you work at least three days a week on Campus, with flexible hours and plenty of opportunity to spend additional time onsite (between 06:00 and 20:00).
A free shuttle bus that takes you to and from the metro station in Maassluis, ensuring your workday starts and ends smoothly.
And of course: we love to celebrate! Whether it’s an anniversary or the annual Christmas party. At Lely, we know how to do it. For an impression of our events, take a look at this video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6WA3e0WHbxE

We are also proud that our vision and efforts have been recognized with the Rotterdam Entrepreneurs Award 2025.

Recruitment & selection agency, consultancy, and/or staffing agency?

We appreciate the interest, but we recruit all our candidates directly. We understand that as intermediaries, you want to present candidates for our great positions and contribute to our ambitions, but this is not how we have set up our recruitment process. This means that all unsolicited profiles offered on Lely vacancies will be treated as direct applications.

About Lely

Founded in 1948, Lely is committed to a sustainable, profitable, and enjoyable future in agriculture. Driven by the challenges faced by farmers and the needs of cows, we develop high-quality robots and data systems that improve animal welfare, flexibility, and productivity on dairy farms. Our mission is to support sustainable food production.

For more than 30 years, we have been a global leader in the sale and service of automated systems for successive generations of dairy farmers. Every day, we inspire our colleagues to offer customers innovative solutions and to be a reliable partner for long-term advice and support. With our state-of-the-art Lely Campus in Maassluis and a global network of dedicated Lely Centers offering customized sales and service, Lely is active in more than fifty countries.

Software Engineer [m|f|d]

Individually tailored to your skills, you will take on challenging and varied tasks in our development department. We are looking for experienced employees as well as newcomers who want to get started with enthusiasm and support from our experienced developers.

Depending on your experience, strengths, and personal preference you will work on desktop, mobile or web/cloud applications.

Our Techstack

C#, .NET, WinForms, DevExpress, Xamarin, MAUI, ASP.NET Core, Blazor, Oracle Database, Azure SQL Database, Azure Cosmos DB, Microsoft Azure

Your Tasks

Design, develop and maintain our world-class logistics applications.
Be involved in shaping our system architecture and application framework.
Implement unit and integration tests to ensure quality, performance, and maintainability.
Write technical specifications and documentation to ensure clear understanding and facilitate future development.
Collaborate with an international team of software engineers, product managers and other colleagues.

Your Traits

Bring good problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
Bring curiosity, passion for technology and the urge to continuously improve your skills.

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in computer science, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
Experience with software development in one or more programming languages
Experience with object-orientation, data structures, algorithms, and design patterns

jobs.description:
About The Company

The Best of Both Worlds

At Maisa, we believe great work happens when people have the freedom to choose the setup that works best for them.

Prefer the flexibility of remote work?

You’re welcome to work remotely. Most of our roles are currently focused on Spain, although depending on the position and profile, we may be open to hiring from other locations.

Looking for some social energy?

Our hybrid setup gives you the option to connect and work alongside teammates at our hubs in Valencia, Barcelona, Madrid and Murcia

. And as we grow, our spaces will grow with us: when we build a team of more than 10 people in a location, our ambition is to create a hub there too.

We also want the time we spend together in person to be worth it. Today, that includes weekly transportation from the city center to our Valencia headquarters

and weekly team lunches in Valencia and Barcelona

, with more experiences to come as our teams and hubs evolve.

The Culture is OURS to Create

We’re still shaping how we work together—and that’s part of what makes joining Maisa now specifically exciting.

Everyone who joins has the opportunity to influence how we collaborate, connect, and build our culture. Rather than inheriting a finished playbook, you’ll have a voice in creating it.

Remote when you want flexibility. Together when you want connection. And a culture you can help shape from day one.

Welcome to Maisa – Making AI Accountable!

Maisa is building the next generation of Agentic Process Automation
, helping enterprises automate complex, decision-heavy processes that traditional automation can’t handle and GenAI alone can’t be trusted with. Our platform combines AI-driven reasoning with deterministic execution, enabling reliable, auditable, and enterprise-ready AI systems.

About The Role…

We’re seeking Forward Deployed Engineers to work at the intersection of engineering, product, and customers, deploying and adapting Maisa Studio
, our flagship Agentic Process Automation platform, to solve real-world enterprise problems.

Customer-Facing Engineering
Work directly with enterprise customers to understand their processes and goals. Design and implement solutions using Maisa Studio to automate complex workflows, acting as a trusted technical partner during onboarding and deployment while translating requirements into technical implementations and product feedback.

Collaboration & Product Feedback
Partner with product and engineering teams to influence roadmap development. Surface customer needs, edge cases, and scalability concerns while defining best practices, reference architectures, and reusable components that accelerate delivery.

Reliability, Security & Quality
Ensure deployments meet enterprise standards for reliability, performance, and security. Support customers in regulated environments by aligning with compliance requirements and collaborating with QA, SRE, and AppSec teams for stable rollouts.

What You’ll Do…

You will work closely with enterprise customers and internal teams to deliver robust, secure, and maintainable deployments in complex, often regulated environments, across 2 key technical domains:

Integrations & Supporting Services (Build what makes the use case work)

Configure, extend, and integrate Maisa Studio into customer environments, designing end-to-end solutions that include APIs, connectors, webhooks, serverless functions, microservices, and event-driven flows. Translate functional requirements from Automators and Technical Account Managers into concrete technical implementations using Go, Python, or JavaScript, clarifying ambiguities and proposing pragmatic paths forward. Ensure robustness through strong engineering practices including testing, logging, monitoring, and documentation. Troubleshoot complex issues across distributed systems and support handover to internal teams or customers when applicable.

Customer Infrastructure Deployments / DevOps (On-prem & Customer Cloud)

Design and support deployments of Maisa Studio in customer environments, including on-premise and customer-managed cloud infrastructures. Work closely with customer DevOps, SRE, and Security teams to achieve production readiness, configuring platform requirements including authentication (OIDC, SAML), IAM, networking (VPNs, DNS, ingress/egress), and operational controls (deployment pipelines, monitoring, backups, high availability). Diagnose and resolve deployment-level incidents, ensure the platform operates within customer security and compliance requirements, and produce clear operational documentation including runbooks, deployment patterns, and troubleshooting guides.

What You’ll Bring…

You have strong experience as a Software Engineer, Solutions Engineer, DevOps/SRE Engineer, or Forward Deployed Engineer in customer-facing or delivery-oriented roles. You're comfortable operating in ambiguous environments, moving quickly from problem to solution while maintaining reliability, with strong troubleshooting skills across code, integrations, and infrastructure. You bring a customer-first mindset and can explain technical concepts clearly to drive alignment.

We are seeking candidates with one of two skill sets, or a mix of both:

Integrations & Supporting Services (Build what makes the use case work)

Strong experience as a backend or full-stack developer shipping production systems.
Hands-on experience with APIs, microservices, and event-driven architectures/queues.
Familiarity with serverless and integration patterns commonly used in enterprise environments.
Strong debugging skills and comfort operating across code, infrastructure touchpoints, and workflow logic.

Customer Infrastructure Deployments / DevOps (On-prem & Customer Cloud)

Strong experience in DevOps / SRE, supporting production workloads.
Hands-on knowledge of Kubernetes, cloud providers and/or on-prem infrastructure, and networking fundamentals.
Practical experience with security and identity standards: OIDC, SAML, VPNs, certificates, and IAM concepts.
Ability to quickly understand customer infrastructure and adapt to their tools and processes.
Clear, structured communication with technical stakeholders in customer organizations.

Why join Maisa!

You will be joining one of Europe’s most exciting early-stage AI start-ups, where you’ll have the opportunity to work with cutting-edge Agentic Process Automation that’s reshaping how enterprises approach AI deployment. You will get to directly influence how major multinational organizations transform critical business processes, working on genuinely differentiated technology that solves real enterprise AI challenges.

Following our recent $25m Seed Round, backed by leading Venture Capital firms including Creandum, Forgepoint, NFX, and Village Global, we’re scaling quickly and realising significant enterprise traction. This is your opportunity to help solve real AI enterprise challenges, working alongside deep technical and industry experts, where you will be challenged daily and expedite your learning and development.

Maisa is committed to Equal Employment Opportunity through attracting and retaining a complementary team of employees and building an inclusive environment for all.

By submitting this application, I agree that my personal data will be collected, processed, and retained by the company solely for the purposes of managing and assessing my candidacy.

The Best of Both Worlds

At Maisa, we believe great work happens when people have the freedom to choose the setup that works best for them.

Prefer the flexibility of remote work?

You’re welcome to work remotely. Most of our roles are currently focused on Spain, although depending on the position and profile, we may be open to hiring from other locations.

Looking for some social energy?

Our hybrid setup gives you the option to connect and work alongside teammates at our hubs in Valencia, Barcelona, Madrid and Murcia

. And as we grow, our spaces will grow with us: when we build a team of more than 10 people in a location, our ambition is to create a hub there too.

We also want the time we spend together in person to be worth it. Today, that includes weekly transportation from the city center to our Valencia headquarters

and weekly team lunches in Valencia and Barcelona

, with more experiences to come as our teams and hubs evolve.

The Culture is OURS to Create

We’re still shaping how we work together—and that’s part of what makes joining Maisa now specifically exciting.

Everyone who joins has the opportunity to influence how we collaborate, connect, and build our culture. Rather than inheriting a finished playbook, you’ll have a voice in creating it.

Remote when you want flexibility. Together when you want connection. And a culture you can help shape from day one.

Welcome to Maisa – Making AI Accountable!

Maisa is building the next generation of Agentic Process Automation
, helping enterprises automate complex, decision-heavy processes that traditional automation can’t handle and GenAI alone can’t be trusted with. Our platform combines AI-driven reasoning with deterministic execution, enabling reliable, auditable, and enterprise-ready AI systems.

About The Role…

We’re seeking Forward Deployed Engineers to work at the intersection of engineering, product, and customers, deploying and adapting Maisa Studio
, our flagship Agentic Process Automation platform, to solve real-world enterprise problems.

Customer-Facing Engineering
Work directly with enterprise customers to understand their processes and goals. Design and implement solutions using Maisa Studio to automate complex workflows, acting as a trusted technical partner during onboarding and deployment while translating requirements into technical implementations and product feedback.

Collaboration & Product Feedback
Partner with product and engineering teams to influence roadmap development. Surface customer needs, edge cases, and scalability concerns while defining best practices, reference architectures, and reusable components that accelerate delivery.

Reliability, Security & Quality
Ensure deployments meet enterprise standards for reliability, performance, and security. Support customers in regulated environments by aligning with compliance requirements and collaborating with QA, SRE, and AppSec teams for stable rollouts.

What You’ll Do…

You will work closely with enterprise customers and internal teams to deliver robust, secure, and maintainable deployments in complex, often regulated environments, across 2 key technical domains:

Integrations & Supporting Services (Build what makes the use case work)

Configure, extend, and integrate Maisa Studio into customer environments, designing end-to-end solutions that include APIs, connectors, webhooks, serverless functions, microservices, and event-driven flows. Translate functional requirements from Automators and Technical Account Managers into concrete technical implementations using Go, Python, or JavaScript, clarifying ambiguities and proposing pragmatic paths forward. Ensure robustness through strong engineering practices including testing, logging, monitoring, and documentation. Troubleshoot complex issues across distributed systems and support handover to internal teams or customers when applicable.

Customer Infrastructure Deployments / DevOps (On-prem & Customer Cloud)

Design and support deployments of Maisa Studio in customer environments, including on-premise and customer-managed cloud infrastructures. Work closely with customer DevOps, SRE, and Security teams to achieve production readiness, configuring platform requirements including authentication (OIDC, SAML), IAM, networking (VPNs, DNS, ingress/egress), and operational controls (deployment pipelines, monitoring, backups, high availability). Diagnose and resolve deployment-level incidents, ensure the platform operates within customer security and compliance requirements, and produce clear operational documentation including runbooks, deployment patterns, and troubleshooting guides.

What You’ll Bring…

You have strong experience as a Software Engineer, Solutions Engineer, DevOps/SRE Engineer, or Forward Deployed Engineer in customer-facing or delivery-oriented roles. You're comfortable operating in ambiguous environments, moving quickly from problem to solution while maintaining reliability, with strong troubleshooting skills across code, integrations, and infrastructure. You bring a customer-first mindset and can explain technical concepts clearly to drive alignment.

We are seeking candidates with one of two skill sets, or a mix of both:

Integrations & Supporting Services (Build what makes the use case work)

Strong experience as a backend or full-stack developer shipping production systems.
Hands-on experience with APIs, microservices, and event-driven architectures/queues.
Familiarity with serverless and integration patterns commonly used in enterprise environments.
Strong debugging skills and comfort operating across code, infrastructure touchpoints, and workflow logic.

Customer Infrastructure Deployments / DevOps (On-prem & Customer Cloud)

Strong experience in DevOps / SRE, supporting production workloads.
Hands-on knowledge of Kubernetes, cloud providers and/or on-prem infrastructure, and networking fundamentals.
Practical experience with security and identity standards: OIDC, SAML, VPNs, certificates, and IAM concepts.
Ability to quickly understand customer infrastructure and adapt to their tools and processes.
Clear, structured communication with technical stakeholders in customer organizations.

Why join Maisa!

You will be joining one of Europe’s most exciting early-stage AI start-ups, where you’ll have the opportunity to work with cutting-edge Agentic Process Automation that’s reshaping how enterprises approach AI deployment. You will get to directly influence how major multinational organizations transform critical business processes, working on genuinely differentiated technology that solves real enterprise AI challenges.

Following our recent $25m Seed Round, backed by leading Venture Capital firms including Creandum, Forgepoint, NFX, and Village Global, we’re scaling quickly and realising significant enterprise traction. This is your opportunity to help solve real AI enterprise challenges, working alongside deep technical and industry experts, where you will be challenged daily and expedite your learning and development.

Maisa is committed to Equal Employment Opportunity through attracting and retaining a complementary team of employees and building an inclusive environment for all.

By submitting this application, I agree that my personal data will be collected, processed, and retained by the company solely for the purposes of managing and assessing my candidacy.

jobs.title: Mid/Senior .NET Backend Engineer [working in Portugal's time zone]
jobs.description:
Descrição da vaga

We are one of the fastest-growing technology and innovation groups in Latin America, and since 2021, we’ve been operating in Portugal.

We are currently collaborating with a leading global e-commerce group, present in Asia, Europe and in the Americas. In this context, we are looking for someone with energy, a sense of responsibility, and motivation to take on the role of Mid/Senior .NET Backend Engineer , in one of the strategic initiatives we are leading with this client.

We work across various domains, including Unified Commerce, Application Development, AI (of course), and Cybersecurity, with over 1,700 professionals distributed across 12 companies in Brazil, Portugal, and the United Kingdom – through projects, managed services, squads, and staff augmentation.

Portugal serves as our service hub for the Northern Hemisphere. From here, our team supports clients in Portugal, the European Union, the United Kingdom, and the United States.

In Europe, in addition to the FCamara brand as a technology service provider, we are also the main investor and shareholder of Beta-i, a leading name in the field of open and collaborative innovation.

At FCamara, members of our consulting and service teams – proudly known as Orange Blood – find a space to grow and develop their skills. We work on challenging initiatives with real impact, creating the conditions for a true professional leap.

Whether joining with prior experience or through our Orange Juice programme, we are proud that many of our talents have gone on to become entrepreneurs or have progressed into leadership roles such as CTOs, IT Directors, Innovation Leads, or other senior positions in companies around the world.

"Those who join FCamara usually leave much better than when they arrived." – said by former Orange Bloods, not by us.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

As a Backend Engineer, you will join our Porto Team to develop internal products that power our business areas. You will pair with Product Managers and other Engineers to define, plan, execute, and foster a culture of technical excellence.

What You’ll Do

Help the team define, plan, and execute complex features. Help the team through the full lifecycle, from initial design to production monitoring, ensuring high availability and performance.
Pair with the Product Manager and other Engineers on discovery and prioritisation. You don't just execute tasks, you translate high-level business requirements into scalable technical specifications.
Design and implement sophisticated event-driven architectures and distributed systems.
Create and maintain high-quality architectural diagrams and system documentation, ensuring the "technical source of truth" is always accurate and accessible.
Act as the subject matter expert in .NET (C#), PostgreSQL/SQL Server, REST APIs

Requisitos e qualificações

jobs.description:
Join Schneider Electric's Building Management System Team in Lund

We are currently seeking a highly motivated and enthusiastic Full Stack Developer
to help develop Schneider Electric's corporate Building Management System (BMS) platform
.

We are looking for a talented, hands-on engineer with experience in both C# and React
to join our development department in Lund. As a member of our R&D organization, you will work closely with development teams both locally and globally. Our state-of-the-art platform provides foundational technology that enables the digitization of solutions, helping customers manage buildings more efficiently and sustainably.

In this role, you will be responsible for creating applications from scratch, configuring existing systems, and providing user support within our BMS platform. You should be able to write functional code with a sharp eye for spotting defects, while thriving in a dynamic and iterative Agile development environment. You are a collaborative team player, a strong communicator, and committed to software engineering best practices.

Responsibilities

Participate in requirements analysis
Design, build, and maintain efficient, secure, reusable, and reliable code
Ensure the best possible performance, quality, and responsiveness of applications
Identify bottlenecks and bugs, and devise solutions to mitigate and address these issues
Help maintain code quality, organization, and automatization

Required Skills And Experience

Solid knowledge of C#
Knowledge of React and TypeScript
Experience developing applications in React, including component design and state management for specific use cases
Knowledge of HTML and CSS
Solid understanding of Object-Oriented Design & Analysis
Solid experience writing modular code that is clear, testable, and maintainable
Familiarity with software design and architectural patterns
Familiarity with Test-Driven Development (TDD), continuous integration, and Agile software development best practices
Bachelor's degree or higher in Software Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field
Good verbal and written English communication skills

Desired Skills And Experience

SQL and databases
Python
Open source technologies and tools
C++
Graph databases and SPARQL

About The Team

The Building Management System (BMS) team is a cross-functional squad working together to develop sophisticated digital building management solutions within Schneider Electric's Buildings Business.

We develop the complete system solution, from IoT sensors and controllers to backend services and modern web applications. While we are proud of what we have built so far, we continuously strive to improve both our technology and our ways of working. In true Agile fashion, we prioritize learning, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

The team fosters a culture of trust, knowledge sharing, and innovation, where every team member has the opportunity to contribute and grow.

This is a great opportunity to join Schneider Electric and power your career. You will become part of an international, dynamic, and responsible company with a strong reputation for innovation and sustainability.

Our Building Management System platform is one of the pillars of Schneider Electric's EcoStruxure offering.

We develop digital solutions that help customers operate buildings more efficiently, reduce environmental impact, save energy, and optimize performance. By connecting devices, data, and people, we enable smarter buildings and more sustainable operations worldwide.
